result:
All research is complete — six agents plus my own graph queries covered every question. Answers below.

# BATTERY-2 answers

## Hard questions

**h01.** `s3presign.Runner` (server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:16) — every 12 hours (`runnerInterval = time.Hour * 12`, server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:27; ticker loop at :29-41) — wired in `Server.startBackgroundRunners`: constructed at server/server.go:162, immediate `RunOnce` at server/server.go:163, goroutine `Run` at server/server.go:169 (invoked from `Start` at server/server.go:129). It re-presigns S3 attachment URLs before their 5-day expiry (runner.go:85-123).

**h02.** Delivery function: `webhook.Post` — internal/webhook/webhook.go:120 (HTTP request issued at :152; async workers call it via `PostAsync`, :184). Protection: SSRF guard — a custom dialer `safeDialContext` (internal/webhook/webhook.go:59-77, wired into `safeClient` at :32-37) rejects any resolved address in `reservedCIDRs` (loopback/RFC1918/link-local/IMDS/IPv6 ULA — internal/webhook/validate.go:14-23, `isReservedIP` :44-54), plus write-time `ValidateURL` (internal/webhook/validate.go:62-83) at webhook create/update (server/router/api/v1/user_service_webhooks.go:74,161,182). Opt-out flag `--allow-private-webhooks` (cmd/memos/main.go:133).

**h03.** Abstraction package: `internal/idp` (normalized `IdentityProviderUserInfo` type, internal/idp/idp.go:3 — note there is no Go interface, just the shared contract type); implementation package: `internal/idp/oauth2` (`oauth2.IdentityProvider`, internal/idp/oauth2/oauth2.go:20, constructed at server/router/api/v1/auth_service_sso.go:121). OAuth2 is the only shipped implementation (proto enum has only `OAUTH2`, proto/gen/store/idp.pb.go:28).

**h04.** No. The only construction of the MySQL driver is in the factory: `mysql.NewDB(profile)` at store/db/db.go:22 inside `NewDBDriver` (store/db/db.go:14). Evidence: `grep -rn "store/db/mysql"` shows exactly one importer, the factory itself (store/db/db.go:8); no other file calls `mysql.NewDB`. The only other `mysql.DB` construction is a zero-value `&DB{}` in an in-package unit test (store/db/mysql/auth_config_test.go:12), which never opens a connection.

**h05.** Explicit Go code (per-driver SQL in the user-delete transaction), not a DB rule. Evidence: `deleteUserTargetsTx` deletes reactions before memos — `deleteReactionsByContentIDsTx` (store/db/sqlite/user_delete.go:380, called at :96) and `deleteReactionsByCreatorTx` (`DELETE FROM reaction WHERE creator_id = ?`, store/db/sqlite/user_delete.go:400, called at :102); mirrored in store/db/postgres/user_delete.go:380,400 and store/db/mysql/user_delete.go:417,437. Checked and absent: no FK/`ON DELETE CASCADE` on `reaction` in any dialect (store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql:91-98, postgres/LATEST.sql:90-98, mysql/LATEST.sql:90-98; the only FK is on `memo_share`), no triggers touching `reaction` (only `updated_ts` triggers, store/migration/sqlite/0.6/00__recreate_triggers.sql), no vacuum/cleanup runner.

**h06.** Handlers: `CreateMemo` (server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:70, dispatch :157), `UpdateMemo` (memo_service.go:401, dispatch :513 via `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects`, memo_update_helpers.go:66), `DeleteMemo` (memo_service.go:518, dispatch :562), `CreateMemoComment` (memo_service_comments.go:20, dispatch :119), plus `SetMemoRelations` (memo_relation_service.go:48) and `SetMemoAttachments` (memo_attachment_service.go:48). Convergence function: `webhook.Post` — internal/webhook/webhook.go:120 (every path enqueues via `webhook.PostAsync`, internal/webhook/webhook.go:184, whose 4 worker goroutines call `Post` at :46; HTTP executed at :152).

**h07.** (Avatar URLs are rewritten to `/file/users/{username}/avatar` at server/router/api/v1/user_service_converters.go:32-38; no gRPC avatar handler exists.)
- Route `GET /file/users/:identifier/avatar` — server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:124 (registered from server/server.go:81-82)
- `(*FileServerService).serveUserAvatar` — server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:168
- `getUserByUsername` — server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:715
- `(*Store).GetUser` — store/user.go:148
- `(*Store).ListUsers` → `s.driver.ListUsers` — store/user.go:136-137
- `(*DB).ListUsers` (sqlite default; `avatar_url` selected/scanned) — store/db/sqlite/user.go:88 (:159, :189)
- `parseDataURI` base64-decodes the stored data-URI and the handler writes the bytes — server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:737-750, response at :205-209

**h08.**
- `*s3presign.Runner` — server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:43 — invoked: yes — callers: server/server.go:163 (startup one-shot) and server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:36 (ticker loop in `Run`)
- `*memopayload.Runner` — server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27 — invoked: no (dead code; neither it nor `memopayload.NewRunner` has any caller, production or test — only the free function `RebuildMemoPayload` from that package is used)

**h09.** Count: 6 project-declared `Close` methods (plus 2 test-only declarations in store/test/filter_helpers_test.go:200,282, and the `store.Driver`/cache interface contracts). All 6 are invoked from non-test code: `Store.Close` (store/store.go:72) called at server/server.go:146; the three driver Closes — sqlite (store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go:67), mysql (store/db/mysql/mysql.go:47), postgres (store/db/postgres/postgres.go:46) — via interface dispatch at store/store.go:78; `cache.Cache.Close` (store/cache/cache.go:187) called at store/store.go:74-76; `SSEHub.Close` (server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go:99) called at server/server.go:206.

**h10.** `NewEngine` — internal/filter/engine.go:24 — ~32 callers (highest fan-in in the index; ~30 of those are test files). If tests are excluded, the highest is the method `addArg` — internal/filter/render.go:842 — with 28 production call sites.

**h11.** 1st: `User` (~9 packages outside store's root: server/auth, server/notification, server/router/api/v1, server/router/fileserver, server/router/rss + the three store/db driver packages); 2nd: `Memo` (~7: server/notification, server/router/api/v1, server/router/rss, server/runner/memopayload + the three driver packages). Excluding the store/db drivers the ranking holds (User 5, Memo 4).

**h12.** `(*DB).CreateMemo` in store/db/sqlite/memo.go:16, INSERT built/executed at store/db/sqlite/memo.go:41-42. Determination: the `--driver` flag defaults to `"sqlite"` (cmd/memos/main.go:122,130 → profile at cmd/memos/main.go:43), the factory `NewDBDriver` switches on it and takes the sqlite branch (store/db/db.go:18-20), and `Store.CreateMemo` delegates through the `store.Driver` interface (store/memo.go:113, interface at store/driver.go:29). The mysql (store/db/mysql/memo.go:16) and postgres (store/db/postgres/memo.go:16) candidates run only with an explicit non-default `--driver`.

**h13.** Impl: unexported `service` struct wrapping goldmark v1.8.2 (internal/markdown/markdown.go:58, engine built at :103 with GFM plus in-repo tag/mention extensions) — the sole implementer of `markdown.Service` (internal/markdown/markdown.go:31). Construction: `markdown.NewService(...)` (internal/markdown/markdown.go:85), single production site in `NewAPIV1Service` (server/router/api/v1/v1.go:48-50). Holders: `APIV1Service.MarkdownService` (server/router/api/v1/v1.go:35) and `RSSService.MarkdownService` (server/router/rss/rss.go:45, injected at server/server.go:85); a third holder, `memopayload.Runner` (server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:16), is dead code.

**h14.** Computation site: `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` (server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74) calling `markdown.Service.ExtractAll` (internal/markdown/markdown.go:356). Triggers: `CreateMemo` (server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108), the `content` branch of `UpdateMemo`'s update mask (server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:447), and indirectly `CreateMemoComment` via `CreateMemo` (server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:56) — the batch runner exists but is never scheduled. Extracted: `Payload.Tags` (runner.go:85) and `Payload.Property` (runner.go:86) = `Title` (first-H1), `HasLink`, `HasCode`, `HasTaskList`, `HasIncompleteTasks` (internal/markdown/markdown.go:387-403).

**h15.**
- gRPC memo service central read check `checkMemoReadAccess` (used by GetMemo, comments, reactions, attachments) — server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:39 (GetMemo at :356)
- `ListMemos` default visibility filter (anonymous → PUBLIC only; authed → own ∨ PUBLIC/PROTECTED CEL filter) — server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:218-226
- Attachment file serving checks parent memo visibility: `checkAttachmentPermission` — server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:650 (public short-circuit :677, private→creator/admin :699)
- RSS feeds hard-code PUBLIC-only — server/router/rss/rss.go:90 and rss.go:141
- SSE event delivery gate `SSEClient.canReceive` — server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go:134-143
- Sitemap PUBLIC-only — server/router/frontend/frontend.go:149-151
- Notification-side gate `canViewerAccessMemo` — server/router/api/v1/user_service_notifications.go:302-315 (duplicate in server/notification/email.go:307-320)

## Reality checks

**r01.** False premise — there is no Redis anywhere (zero hits in `*.go`, go.mod, go.sum). The cache layer is a hand-rolled in-process cache built on `sync.Map` with per-item expiration (store/cache/cache.go:66-73) and a cleanup goroutine (store/cache/cache.go:200-215). User entries use the shared config `DefaultTTL: 10 * time.Minute` (store/store.go:40-45), applied to `userCache`/`userSettingCache`/`instanceSettingCache` (store/store.go:51-53).

**r02.** False premise — no rate-limiting middleware exists at all (only grep hit is a doc comment at internal/email/doc.go:86; no limiter library in go.mod). The actual interceptor chain is Metadata, Logging, Recovery, and Auth interceptors (server/router/api/v1/v1.go:133-138); the closest limits are a 256 MiB body cap (v1.go:20,126,143) and global image/thumbnail concurrency semaphores (v1.go:59-60), which are not rate limits.

**r03.** False premise twice over — there is no database-cleanup job, and the cron scheduler (`internal/scheduler`) is dead code with zero imports outside its own package (its doc.go:14-21 example of a `"daily-cleanup"` job at `0 2 * * *` is illustrative documentation only). The only scheduled job is the s3presign runner on a plain 12-hour `time.Ticker` (server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:27, wired at server/server.go:153-173).

**r04.** Neither — false premise; no NATS, RabbitMQ, AMQP, or Kafka appears in any Go file or go.mod. Webhook delivery uses an in-process buffered channel: `asyncPostQueue = make(chan *WebhookRequestPayload, 128)` (internal/webhook/webhook.go:39), drained by 4 goroutine workers started in `init()` (internal/webhook/webhook.go:42-54); `PostAsync` enqueues non-blocking and silently drops when full (internal/webhook/webhook.go:184-197). No broker, no persistence, no retries.

**r05.** False premise — there is no GraphQL schema (zero hits for graphql/gqlgen in code, go.mod, or proto/). The public API is defined as Protobuf gRPC services in proto/api/v1/*.proto (9 files), exposed via grpc-gateway REST (registered at server/router/api/v1/v1.go:96-122, mounted at :129-130), Connect-RPC for browsers (v1.go:139-143), and SSE (v1.go:125), plus auxiliary RSS/fileserver/MCP routers registered in server/server.go:66-96.
